name: winpilot-command-bar
description: A safety-first Windows command bar for AI and local tasks

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch" "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 dist/main/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
